donor_reference.role: Quiet broad metallic facets, edge contrast and compact resource-art shading only. The actual donor is a rounded steel lump, not a bent sheet; no close complete equivalent selected. Do not copy nugget outline, brown palette, stack variants or steel-smelting mechanics. Source Qud silhouette and bent-sheet identity govern.

interpretation.source_supported: Bent metal sheet from machine-fossil scrap, two opposing P/D triangular areas within diamond-like border, native B/C contrast, takeable non-solid stackable/disassemblable scrap.
interpretation.authored: Shallow curled fold along each occupied sheet edge, broad dent, fine crease and a thin surviving rim. Native empty quadrants stay open rather than becoming solid gray sheet.
interpretation.prohibited: No electronic traces/pads, chip housing, pins, wires, gears, riveted plate stack or intact rectangular sheet replacing source form.

registration.policy: Preserve source8x8visible extent in common full-cell frame; do not fill image bounds or normalize each source scrap independently.
